senses.definition: n.pr.m. & f. (my father is might, Sab. אבחיל HalMA 234)—prob. = אֲבִיהַיִל 2 Ch 11:18, אֲבִיהָ֑יִל 1 Ch 2:29—
a Gadite 1 Ch 5:14.
father of Esther Est 2:15; 9:29.
wife of Abishur 1 Ch 2:29.
wife of Rehoboam 2 Ch 11:18.
